test_title: PYST 3: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 5 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In Row 1 – A, B, C, D and E are seated and all of them are facing the south.

In Row 2 – P, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing the north.

Thus, each person is facing another person from the other row.

B is sitting third to the left of A. P is facing an immediate neighbour of A. Q is sitting third to the right of P. C is facing S. D is sitting second to the right of the person who is facing T. Who amongst the following is NOT sitting at any of the extreme ends of the row?
solution:
**Given:**

In Row 1 – A, B, C, D and E are seated and all of them are facing the south.

In Row 2 – P, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing the north.

1. B is sitting third to the left of A.

**Case 1:**

**Case 2:**

**Case 1:**

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a8edc2e76f1cd3038de189c17bf498bb139adecb92c0a070d90046bc5ddc939.png] 

4. D is sitting second to the right of the person who is facing T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2544dd99f6cfa04be891aabdc6aae45ff70dec05bc4a84d8d88765422e48ebb.png] 

Here, **'C'** is not sitting at the end.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
